headline: A platform for finding local manufacturers and suppliers for investment projects has been launched in Uzbekistan
summary: A platform connecting manufacturers, investors and large buyers in Uzbekistan has launched. Its catalogue holds about 80,000 products and information on more than 46,000 companies. Investors can seek local suppliers through it.
why: Matching investment projects with domestic suppliers supports local industry development and import substitution, which matter for investors in Uzbekistan's growing economy.
original_headline: O‘zbekistonda investitsiya loyihalari uchun mahalliy ishlab chiqaruvchilar va yetkazib beruvchilarni topish platformasi ishga tushirildi
